what: Once a single brush-script line reaches the 80% line of the screen, the letters thunk in one by one like stamps. With no in-between values (set), one lifts .65em and tilts 4° then settles .3s later, another is pressed down 1.3em at −6° → .3s later .65em·−4° → .3s later in place, and another tilts 6° then straightens .3s later. Original order (ten characters): lift 0~.3 · lift .2~.6 · still · press .6~1.2 · tilt .9~1.2 · tilt 1.2~1.5 · still · still · lift 1.6~1.9 · lift 1.8~2.2
ease: None — cuts and switches per set

options.[data-fx-part=char]: Each character to be typed (blank characters also take a turn)
options.lift: Lift height (em), default .65 — the press starts at twice that
options.lift-sp: Lift height (em) at 750px and below, default .35
options.seq: Per letter step, give ‹type start end› separated by commas — lift, press, tilt, - (still). Default is the original ten-letter sequence
options.start: ScrollTrigger start, default 0% 80% · none starts immediately on attach

use: WomanFlag…

from.where: index.html .intro__catch (brush-script intro line) — the original is a brush-written SVG per letter, tilt axis at the bottom center of the letter (svgOrigin)
